text:
The Ann–Ben block is consecutive, with Cara before Elif before Ann, and Gus at least three slots after Ann. The only slot pair that also leaves Dev before Gus and at least three slots from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7, which places Gus in 9 and Hana in 8.

The first five slots are then fixed: Dev must be in 1 to stay three from both Cara and Ann, Finn in 2 to stay three from both Ben and Elif, Ivo in 3 to stay three from Ben while remaining before Gus, Cara in 4, and Elif in 5. Every constraint holds, and every other Ann–Ben placement breaks an order or distance constraint.
